description: This file is a shell script used for testing rebase performance in a Git repository. It sets up various rebasing scenarios with different configurations including large numbers of commits and split-index mode, and runs corresponding Git commands to measure performance.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or resets the default test repository environment.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a section of the test that expects success, with a description and a set of commands.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for iterating or generating file contents.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates the passage of time or marks a point in the test sequence.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes, possibly with a custom message.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
